cohort: The study included 200 pregnant patients admitted to the antenatal ward and labour room, divided into a control group (37-40 weeks gestational age) and a study group (>40 weeks gestational age).
finding: Postdated pregnancies are associated with a higher rate of LSCS and instrumental deliveries.
mod_finding: The study found that the percentage of LSCS was 30% in the postdated pregnancy group compared to 15% in the control group, and instrumental delivery was 10% versus 5%.
gest_age: 37-40 weeks (control group); >40 weeks (study group, majority 40-41 weeks)
